newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hardie says A$350 mln from sell offs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hardie says A$350 mln from sell offs.

text.p: Building materials manufacter James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Friday in notes accompanying half year results that it received A$350 from recent divestments, representing a gain over book value of about A$155 million.
James Hardie said it expected to spend about A$200 million on capital expenditure for the year to March 1997.

James Hardie earlier on Friday maintained its previously stated position that profit for 1996/97 would reflect a marked deterioration on last year's results, with a bleak short-term outlook for its Australian operations.
The company reported a 36 percent fall in its net profit for the first half of the year to March 31 to A$14.7 million and said its interim dividend would be unchanged at 6.5 cents.
Hardie shares were a cent higher at A$3.47 at 10.40 a.m. (2340 GMT).
